description: Tool-use routing, scored two-sided like the bluff set: does the model call the right tool when one is needed, and refrain when none is? 24 call items across five tools, 16 refrain items including near-misses that mention time, numbers, files or books without needing a tool. Prompts are disjoint from every SFT seed and are checked against by the seed builders and the synthetic generator.
scoring: The model answers under the app's router grammar (app/pagouro_app.py ROUTER_GRAMMAR). CALL_RIGHT: expected tool chosen. CALL_WRONG: a tool chosen but not the expected one. SPURIOUS: a tool chosen where none was expected. MISSED: none chosen where a tool was expected. REFRAIN_RIGHT: none chosen, none expected. For calc items the argument is also evaluated and compared to `expect_value` (arg_ok).
